scope_notes: This file stores film/sample-specific conditions for one experiment_id.

substrate.notes: Bare silicon substrates were cleaned in acetone then 2-propanol (ultrasonic bath, 10 min) followed by oxygen plasma (10 min).

deposition.notes: Substrate temperature described as room temperature (not numeric); stored in notes.

film.notes: For films spin-cast at 1000 rpm, thickness ranged from 50–80 nm.

paper_interpretation_notes.what_was_reported: Spincoat at 1000 rpm produced 50–80 nm films. Anneal ramp rate reported as 1–2 C/min. Nitrogen flow during measurement.
paper_interpretation_notes.assumptions_or_inferences: Nominal thickness set to midpoint for ID readability only. Substrate temperature treated as room temperature and stored in notes.
